## National Technical University of Athens {.course-institution}

| Code | Course |
|---|---|
| — | Control and Robotics Systems Lab exercises |

Lab exercises included:

- Three-term (PID) control with analogue circuits
- Servomechanism (ES230) system analysis
- Embedded control system (MIDICOM)
- Design of control systems in MATLAB
- Automatic control of robotic joint
- Classic robot (Adept) control (disturbance compensation)
- Robot (Adept) programming
- Mobile robot (RoboSoft) control
- Robotic palletizing cell (FMS)
- Pendubot control
- Fuzzy inference and control in MATLAB
